description: Pause, resume or archive an agent. paused: it stops working and keeps its setup. archived: it is retired from the account; use this when the owner asks to delete an agent. active: it works again. Tasks that came due while it was paused or archived were paused themselves and stay paused: the result lists them, and update_agent_task with status active resumes each one.
name: set_agent_status
title: Set Agent Status
